My family and I operate a dining inn/retreat/event venue called Hachland Hill.  We offer an authentic Nashville experience. We love nature, good music, good friends, and good food. We offer up to 15 sleeping rooms in two separate inns. On 80 acres, our guests enjoy the best of nature and privacy. Plenty of hiking, outdoor seating and entertainment, like fire pits, corn hole, etc..  We're known for elevated Southern cuisine.  Plan your group or private dining experience with us! Only 25 minutes from the excitement of downtown and from the  airport, you'll find the best of worlds at Hachland Hill.
